data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 proposes a dependence relation ('depends on the absence of a simultaneous constraint representation') but then its own refutation condition directly undermines that relation: if the directionality can be correctly resolved by a mechanism that parses 'X costs $10 more than Y' as N - P = 10 before any substitution — independent of whether both constraints are simultaneously written down — then the error does NOT depend on the absence of a simultaneous constraint representation. The refutation condition explicitly severs the causal link the relation asserts, making the proposed dependence self-refuting rather than substantive. A genuine dependence claim must not be falsified by the very mechanism the target itself admits as sufficient.
